newsitem.title: LATVIA: STABURADZE IN H1 PROFIT OF 485,957 LATS PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: STABURADZE IN H1 PROFIT OF 485,957 LATS PROFIT.

text.p: Staburadze confectionery reported an interim profit of 485,957 lats on turnover of 4.19 million lats, the Riga stock exchange said on Wednesaday.
Staburadze had production costs of 2.86 million lats and sales expenses of 462,525 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
Staburadze's administrative costs amounted to 298,756 lats and it registered a loss of 17,081 lats from other business activities.
It had interest income worth 9,167 lats against interest payments of 6,593 lats, the statement said.
Staburadze's profit before tax and extraordinary items came to 557,717 lats and it paid 75,015 lats in tax and registered after-tax profit of 485,957 lats.
The confectionery plant's balance sheet total is 3.03 million lats and its tangible assets are worth 1.92 million lats.
It also has 331,277 lats worth of payment dues and short-term debts of 333,376 lats, the statement said.
